name: Indiana Dunes State Park
description: Indiana Dunes State Park consists of 2,182 acres of primitive, beautiful, historic and unique Hoosier landscape. It lies at the north end of State Road 49 in Porter County, and includes more than three miles of beautiful beach along Lake Michigan’s southern shore. In the early 1900s scientists, recreationists and nature enthusiasts, recognizing the value and potential of the Indiana dunes area, fought to have the region preserved. As a result, in 1925, the state park was established.Large sand dunes, located beyond the entire shoreline, have taken thousands of years to form, and tower nearly 200 feet above Lake Michigan. A wide range of habitats and plant species are found in the park, with vegetation stabilizing some of the sand. These habitats provide homes for many types of plants and animals. The lake also provides habitat for many aquatic species, as well as a constantly changing fishery.Indiana Dunes State Park features a wide variety of habitats, including beach, sand dunes, black oak forest, wooded wetlands, and a button-bush marsh. Together, these areas contain some of the most diverse flora and fauna in the Midwest. Botanists from across the country enjoy studying the unusual collection of plant life. Other interesting features include “tree graveyards” (places where forests have been buried by sand and then, more recently, re-exposed by wind erosion). “Tree graveyards” can be seen in Big Blowout, near Trail 10. The Indiana Dunes area also is renowned throughout the Midwest for its birding. Visit the Nature Center to ask about good birding locations.Indiana Dunes State Park is surrounded by Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore, a federally administered park comprising approximately 15,000 acres.

name: Shri Trimbakeshwar Temple
description:
Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple:

Located in the picturesque town of Trimbak, Maharashtra, the Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple is a revered and sacred site dedicated to Lord Shiva. It is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, which makes it an immensely significant pilgrimage destination for Hindus.

The temple is set against the backdrop of the Sahyadri mountain range, offering visitors a serene and peaceful environment. The temple complex is beautifully constructed with intricate carvings and a rich architectural style that reflects ancient Hindu temple designs. The main sanctum houses the Trimbakeshwar Shivling, which is unique because it has three faces representing Lord Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. This distinctive feature adds to the temple's spiritual importance.

The temple is not just an architectural marvel but is also surrounded by a tranquil atmosphere, making it a place for reflection and prayer. Visitors can also take a holy dip in the nearby Brahmagiri River, which is believed to purify one’s soul. The temple is located close to the source of the Godavari River, adding to its spiritual significance.

The priests and staff at the temple are warm and helpful, guiding pilgrims through the rituals and offering a complete spiritual experience. The temple is usually crowded, especially during festivals like Mahashivaratri, so planning a visit during less busy times could provide a more peaceful experience.

One unique ritual at the temple is the "Trimbak" puja, which is performed to seek blessings for health, wealth, and prosperity. It is a must-visit for those seeking divine blessings or exploring India's rich spiritual heritage.

Conclusion:
The Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple is not just a place of worship but a sacred site brimming with history, spiritual significance, and natural beauty. Its peaceful surroundings, combined with the deep spiritual energy, make it a must-visit for devotees and travelers alike.

Once a Greek colony, later a haven for people from across the Mediterranean and the Middle East, this gateway to Asia has been an active and diverse hub for eons. Still, visitors to Uskudar are often more overcome by its myriad treasures than by its many thousand residents. And with fairytale settings such as the “Maiden’s Tower” as well as grand examples of Ottoman Era architecture, plenty of parks, a gorgeous and lengthy coastline, and some of Turkey’s holiest sites, there’s no end to the sightseeing possibilities. Easily reached from the city’s European shores via a steady network of ferries, time spent in Uskudar reveals a “real life” Istanbul that many who experience find extremely fascinating.

name: Lake Hollywood Park
description:
I lived in Los Angeles in the 90's and visit often because I have a daughter who lives in Hollywood, and I never knew this gem was here until I searched for running paths on my last visit! I was looking for a relatively flat trail since I'm from Houston, which is very flat. I drove up here, and the parking area is only about 12 minutes from Hollywood Blvd. and La Brea, where I was coming from. It feels a world away from the city below! The reservoir is a beautiful blue lake with wildlife you will easily see, including donkey deer, rabbits, and water birds. The Hollywood sign is just above the park and loop, and you will see it easily and unobstructed from parts of the path.

The loop around the reservoir is 3.3 miles, so the whole thing should be doable for those looking to run a 5k or continuing training for one, as I was. It's also a walking trail that probably takes an hour to an hour and a half to complete, depending upon your walking pace. Of course, you can also visit and only walk as far as you like, turning around to retrace your steps when you want to be halfway done.

Using GPS, put in Lake Hollywood Reservoir to get to the parking area for the trail. I used the 6381 Weidlake Dr address to a free parking area and trail entrance, although I saw there are supposed to be other entrances on Lake Hollywood Drive and Wonder View Drive.

The experience is really wonderful with incredible views of the city below, the water and wildlife, and the Hollywood sign, not to mention the pretty drive up through the Hollywood Hills to get there. I highly recommend it if you're looking for that sort of thing to change up your trip to Los Angeles and the Hollywood area, especially.

name: Corso Vittorio Emanuele II
description: The pulsating core of Milan is in Centro. Duomo Square is enclosed by the gothic cathedral, the historic icon of Milan. However, shopping is what draws most crowds to this area. The classy and versatile Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II with luxury boutiques and high quality restaurants will turn any shopping or lunch expedition into a royal experience. Head to the rooftop of the flagship La Rinascente to enjoy the view of the animated square with a panorama of the Duomo. The Corso Vittorio Emanuele II is the street for high-end shopping. Brands of all kinds and street artists attract the attention of all visitors; while at Via Santa Radegonda 16, Luini Panzerotti is a much appreciated street food shop providing unimaginable culinary experiences. name: Rawal Lake
description: Rawal Lake is impressive in its size. The day I visited it appeared tranquil and serene.If you are arriving by vehicle then access to the lake is gained through parking your vehicle in the very large parking areas and then walking down to the lakeside or catching the small land train that shuttles visitors backwards and forwards.The setting of the park and lake is beautiful. There is a tree lined avenue of Jacaranda trees that looked so pretty.There are also numerous stall holders selling drinks, snacks and ice creams and games to play. The place has a happy and friendly vibe.Once you walk to the lakeside edge you are afforded a great view of the lake. There is a covered viewing area and also an open viewing area, all great for photographs.A big disappointment for me was the rubbish some visitors choose to dispose of in an irresponsible fashion. Litter bins are provided but I did notice litter both in the lake and around the parkland area. I hate seeing litter anywhere, let alone beauty spots like this.There is lots of parkland to enjoy and many areas covered by tree canopies providing some shade from the sun.This is a lovely place to visit and stroll around. I was told it is quieter during the day, probably due to the heat and that it is at night that it gets much busier.

name: Wulong Tiankeng Three Bridges
description: Wulong was our very first stop in our 8-day Chongqing tour. Wulong's attractions are mainly natural scenery, and many are listed at World Natural Heritages. There are four main famous natural attractions in Wulong: the Three Natural Bridges, Furong Cave, Fairy Mountain, and Longshuixia Gap (龙水峡地缝). Our itinerary covered two of them, and our very first destination was this Three Natural Bridges (天生三桥).Nature travels fascinate people like me who are attuned to the hustle and bustle of a modern city life. In Hamlet, William Shakespeare articulated: There are more things in heaven than there are dreams in your philosophy.  At this Nature Three Bridges, it is a pristine world of calmness and peace and far from the madding crowd of our materialistic world. What the eyes see are the sculpture world of Nature: canyon, caves, looming mountain, sinkholes, emerald lakes, waterfalls; no concrete jungle, no polluted air or toxic noise that existed in our world.The Three Natural Bridges (天生三桥) is named as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2007. It became famous due to the filming of the Chinese film Curse of the Golden Flower (满城尽带黄金甲) and followed by the filming of Transformers 4: Age of Extinction The Director Michael Bay probably left the dinosaur autobot at the filming site for remembrance.The karst landscape is amazing and spectacular. The weather is cold, but I lost myself in the nature wonderland as I hiked for 2.5 km to discover the 3 bridges:  天龙桥; 青龙桥" and 黑龙桥. It was a bit challenging for the elderly before one reached the Black Dragon Bridge (黑龙桥) with some stairs to climb, but after this bridge, it is plain walking for the other two dragon bridges.When I hiked to Tianfu Postal House (天福驿站), I found it very photogenic. It looks different and unique with a Chinese architecture postal house surrounded by the karst landscape. I climbed up to a higher platform from the adjacent karst hill and took an iconic photo of this landmark. 天福驿站 was a transmission stop built during the Tang Dynasty for communication between two provinces.I was attracted by an emerald, green lake not far from the end of the trail. A small boat lies in the middle of the lake. The scenery looks very poetic, and in bitter cold winter, it would remind me of the Tang poem (江雪):千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。Our tour guide warned us that this trip covering the Three Bridges is just an appetizer, a warmup exercise. The more challenging hike will be at the Enshi Grand Canyon (恩施 大峡谷) which would be 3 times more challenging than this.Which would a be better hiking attraction: 天生三桥 or 恩施 大峡谷?

name: Fishing Excursions
description: I booked the 7 to 9 am fishing trip on a nitro to be picked up at the grand Floridian. Arrived at 6:30. Went to the boat launch and waited until 7:10. No boats or staff arrived, so I called and was advised that there was an issue with the boat and that they would be at the grand Floridian to pick me up shortly. At 7:30 I was still waiting and called again. This operator put me through to the grand Floridian boat launch and no one picked up. At 7:40 I approached the grand Floridian customer services. I advised the staff member of the situation and he called boat rental. The staff member advised me that the boat is currently on its way to the grand Floridian and if I had just been patient I would probably be on the boat right now. T thanked him and proceeded back to the boat launch. At 8:10 the boat still had not shown up so I called again. The operator was very helpful and after a while, she discovered that the boat believed I was at the contemporary. They did not find me there and went back to their base. The operator had guest service respond to my location to speak with me. Upon their arrival, they advised me that I would be refunded for my trip and I could still use the boat for the remaining half hour of my trip. When I agreed, they reached out and to boat rental and then advised that by the time the boat arrived, my time slot will have ended. They did not have any other time slots available to offer me. They promised me a refund, but provided me with no compensation for my lost time. Terrible experience and extremely disappointing for an avid fisherman such as myself.

name: Kronborg Slot
description: Kronborg is a must-see! “Hamlet’s Castle” is a magnificent experience with soaring towers, a huge ballroom, damp casemates and just 40 minutes from Copenhagen. At the narrowest neck of the sound, between Denmark and Sweden, the medieval fortress merges with the magnificent Renaissance castle and there are few sites in the world where so much drama and history is gathered in one place. Mythical hero Holger the Dane’s mighty sword meets Shakespeare’s equally mighty pen, as the spirit of Hamlet glides through the castle. No wonder this extraordinary place is on UNESCO’s World Heritage List.

name: Laguna El Dudu
description: Laguna Dudu is an exciting and mostly unknown paradise located on the north east coast of the Dominican Republic. It's surrounded by natural cliffs from which to swim, snorkel or free dive into refreshing clear waters. If you love adrenaline rush then try a zip line freefall from 10 meters. You may need to take a deep breath for this adventure. Once you finally takeoff for a subjective six seconds drop in thin air, and finish with a big splash. But it's also a spot worth visiting for it offers a cave to explore, a beautiful cove with other challenging experiences. There are stairs leading down to the water which enables smooth and easy access to both lagoons. With nature to explore and plenty of photographic spots. A visit to Laguna Dudu can easily be combined with two additional beach activities since it's located within minutes between two playas (beaches) Diamante and Arroyo Salado. Your next adventure awaits you. Come, explore and show us your favorite spot.

name: Thermopyles Hot Springs
description: We just stopped here for a short while, but did not actually swim in the spring. The water was comfortably warm (I felt it with my hand), but there is a strong odor of sulphur, which was not pleasant. There were several people swimming there when we visited -- kids and adults. They appeared to be locals. It was worth seeing, since we were already in the area, but I would not go out of my way to visit. Would I go swimming there? Maybe. But I would probably want to shower soon afterwards to wash off the malodorous sulphur-infused water.

name: Hospitalbar

Closest at hand are the Royal Palace, the quaint shops of Haalremmerdijk, the pedestrianized zones Kalverstraat and Dam Square with popular neighborhoods such as the Red Light District, and the Canal Ring hardly more than a moment’s stroll away. With the well-connected Centraal Station as Centrum’s base, it's easy to travel farther afield via one of the city’s iconic trams.

name: Water Holes Canyon
description:
We saw one other tour group of 8-10 people while we were there for 3 hours. If you take photos, you will not have a bunch of other tourists bumping around, shoulder to shoulder, like at the more well-known slot canyons. No hipster instagram people or selfie takers clogging up the place. We were by ourselves for all but 10 minutes of the 3 hour tour!

On this three hour photo tour, we had Shane as our guide. He was extremely friendly and helpful and is also interested in photography. His whole attitude was relaxed and eager to help with getting photos the way you want them. He even played his Indian fluted inside one of the two slot canyon we went through. There was no feeling of being rushed.

This place is only 10 minutes outside of Page and is very convenient. Avoid the crowds and see a couple of beautiful slot canyons in peace.

The trendiest areas are around Shibuya’s Center district, Harajuku's Takeshita-dori and in Omotesando. If you need to recharge from all the shopping, you can easily refresh yourself in Meiji Jingu or Sasaki Park. In contrast, Ebisu has a more grown up ambiance of calm and cool. At the Museum of Yebisu Beer you can learn about the beer that was responsible for the town’s name, and enjoy dining at the popular noodle shops in the surrounding area.

name: Tiger Kingdom Phuket
description: Tiger Kingdom Phuket is a once in a lifetime experience where you can meet, play, and have your photo taken with tigers! Watch the tigers as you kick back with some food and drink from our top-quality restaurant. You are sure to have a very memorable experience! Open daily including public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

name: Rathaus
description: In Vienna's best-known district, pedestrian boulevards Kärntner Strasse and Graben connect you with landmarks such as the Wiener Staatsoper (Vienna State Opera), Vienna’s iconic Stephansdom (St. Stephen’s Cathedral) and the vast compound of Hofburg, the Habsburgs’ former Imperial Palace. Peek down side streets such as Annagasse and Weihburggasse, and Graben’s Seilergasse and Habsburggasse, to get a feel for the center. The Imperial Apartments and the refreshingly demystifying Sissi Museum are must-dos at Hofburg. Spacious squares such as Am Hof and Freyung often host beautiful seasonal and antiques markets.

name: California Science Center
description: Welcome to the California Science Center! While Endeavour is off exhibit, we remain one of the largest science centers in the nation, with multiple hands-on galleries, unforgettable special exhibitions, and immersive IMAX movies. General admission to our permanent exhibits is FREE. ( Excludes special paid exhibits and IMAX Theater.) The California Science Center is a dynamic destination where families, adults and children can explore the wonders of science through interactive exhibits, live demonstrations, innovative programs and awe-inspiring IMAX movies. The California Science Center and IMAX Theater are located in historic Exposition Park just west of the Harbor (110) Freeway at 700 Exposition Park Drive, Los Angeles. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day.

name: Blue Mosque
description: Built between 1609-1616, this impressive mosque has six minarets. Why is it called "Blue Mosque?" There are two stories: the first, more common one is that the interior is covered in Blue İznik tiles. The second is: many years ago, ancient sailors who sailed by the mosque on the Marmara Sea saw the blue colors of the sea reflected in the mosque.

name: Bigfoot Discovery Expedition
description: My family did the Bigfoot Discovery Expedition July 2021.  Everyone had a good time until the end.  Loved feeding the cows and looking at the scenery.  We do not see how the ending fit with finding Bigfoot.The truck drove into a building, the lights were turned out, a foggy mist was released and hot air blown at you from what felt like a heat lamp that was turned on high. In addition to this, monitors played a scene from a drug raid with people kneeling to be executed.  There was shouting, shooting and bombs going off.  It was extremely violent.  This lasted 10-15 minutes.  ave gonWe had a 6 and 8 year old with us who got scared.  Unfortunately we didn't read other reviews under the Big Foot Fun Park that mentioned this ending and were not provided this information prior to purchasing tickets and boarding the truck. If we had, we would not have gone.It totally ruined the fun we had been having. Prior to this, I said I’d do it again with another family member.  After sitting through the end, none of us will go back.If they want to continue with this violent ending, I suggest giving participants the choice of sitting through this ordeal or choosing a fun ending that’s actually related to Big Foot.  Even if it’s just seeing some Big Foot cutouts/statues, that would have been preferable.

name: St. Kitts Scenic Railway
description: The narrow gauge St. Kitts scenic railway is one of the most beautiful train rides in the world. Originally built in 1912 to deliver sugarcane from the fields to the sugar mill in Basseterre, the "Last Railway in the West Indies" now provides a fascinating way for visitors to see the island from the comfort of modern passenger train cars and sightseeing buses. The railway hugs the Northeastern coastline where spectacular vistas of ocean, surf, cliffs, and lush vegetation surround you. The train rolls across tall steel bridges spanning deep ""ghuts"", or canyons, and winds through small villages and farms. Dark green rainforests are skirted by rippling fields of sugar can, with the volcanic cone of Mt. Liamuiga rising above the railway. This unique rail and highway experience allows visitors the opportunity to see the island in a very short period of time. Your guide will point out all the sights as the train passes old sugar estates with abandoned windmills and chimneys.

name: Indiana Dunes State Park
description: Indiana Dunes State Park consists of 2,182 acres of primitive, beautiful, historic and unique Hoosier landscape. It lies at the north end of State Road 49 in Porter County, and includes more than three miles of beautiful beach along Lake Michigan’s southern shore. In the early 1900s scientists, recreationists and nature enthusiasts, recognizing the value and potential of the Indiana dunes area, fought to have the region preserved. As a result, in 1925, the state park was established.Large sand dunes, located beyond the entire shoreline, have taken thousands of years to form, and tower nearly 200 feet above Lake Michigan. A wide range of habitats and plant species are found in the park, with vegetation stabilizing some of the sand. These habitats provide homes for many types of plants and animals. The lake also provides habitat for many aquatic species, as well as a constantly changing fishery.Indiana Dunes State Park features a wide variety of habitats, including beach, sand dunes, black oak forest, wooded wetlands, and a button-bush marsh. Together, these areas contain some of the most diverse flora and fauna in the Midwest. Botanists from across the country enjoy studying the unusual collection of plant life. Other interesting features include “tree graveyards” (places where forests have been buried by sand and then, more recently, re-exposed by wind erosion). “Tree graveyards” can be seen in Big Blowout, near Trail 10. The Indiana Dunes area also is renowned throughout the Midwest for its birding. Visit the Nature Center to ask about good birding locations.Indiana Dunes State Park is surrounded by Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore, a federally administered park comprising approximately 15,000 acres.

Maybe it is because the trees grow in a bent direction or maybe they had more effective demonstrations. There were far more things to try at this vortex than the others, which mainly focus on height changes. Some of the hands on activities are more engaging than others, but there is a wide variety. The guides are also great. They have a lot of enthusiasm and really sell the mystique. The hours can be a little confusing as there is not much information online. It seems the last tour is usually somewhere in the 4:00 hour, so I would say plan to arrive by 4 if you want to catch a tour. Visitors can stand on the corner, snap a photo with the iconic statue, and soak in the nostalgia of this beloved cultural landmark. name: Shri Trimbakeshwar Temple
description:
Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple:

Located in the picturesque town of Trimbak, Maharashtra, the Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple is a revered and sacred site dedicated to Lord Shiva. It is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, which makes it an immensely significant pilgrimage destination for Hindus.

The temple is set against the backdrop of the Sahyadri mountain range, offering visitors a serene and peaceful environment. The temple complex is beautifully constructed with intricate carvings and a rich architectural style that reflects ancient Hindu temple designs. The main sanctum houses the Trimbakeshwar Shivling, which is unique because it has three faces representing Lord Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. This distinctive feature adds to the temple's spiritual importance.

The temple is not just an architectural marvel but is also surrounded by a tranquil atmosphere, making it a place for reflection and prayer. Visitors can also take a holy dip in the nearby Brahmagiri River, which is believed to purify one’s soul. The temple is located close to the source of the Godavari River, adding to its spiritual significance.

The priests and staff at the temple are warm and helpful, guiding pilgrims through the rituals and offering a complete spiritual experience. The temple is usually crowded, especially during festivals like Mahashivaratri, so planning a visit during less busy times could provide a more peaceful experience.

One unique ritual at the temple is the "Trimbak" puja, which is performed to seek blessings for health, wealth, and prosperity. It is a must-visit for those seeking divine blessings or exploring India's rich spiritual heritage.

Conclusion:
The Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple is not just a place of worship but a sacred site brimming with history, spiritual significance, and natural beauty. Its peaceful surroundings, combined with the deep spiritual energy, make it a must-visit for devotees and travelers alike.

The prices in the restaurant / beach bar are the same European prices (max. 1-2€ cheaper). Everything is now very touristy! The view from the parking lot is gigantic! The beach is clean and you can walk superbly into the sea, but even here are many small pointed stones. We therefore recommend bringing bathing shoes or slippers! name: Lake Hollywood Park
description:
I lived in Los Angeles in the 90's and visit often because I have a daughter who lives in Hollywood, and I never knew this gem was here until I searched for running paths on my last visit! I was looking for a relatively flat trail since I'm from Houston, which is very flat. I drove up here, and the parking area is only about 12 minutes from Hollywood Blvd. and La Brea, where I was coming from. It feels a world away from the city below! The reservoir is a beautiful blue lake with wildlife you will easily see, including donkey deer, rabbits, and water birds. The Hollywood sign is just above the park and loop, and you will see it easily and unobstructed from parts of the path.

The loop around the reservoir is 3.3 miles, so the whole thing should be doable for those looking to run a 5k or continuing training for one, as I was. It's also a walking trail that probably takes an hour to an hour and a half to complete, depending upon your walking pace. Of course, you can also visit and only walk as far as you like, turning around to retrace your steps when you want to be halfway done.

Using GPS, put in Lake Hollywood Reservoir to get to the parking area for the trail. I used the 6381 Weidlake Dr address to a free parking area and trail entrance, although I saw there are supposed to be other entrances on Lake Hollywood Drive and Wonder View Drive.

The experience is really wonderful with incredible views of the city below, the water and wildlife, and the Hollywood sign, not to mention the pretty drive up through the Hollywood Hills to get there. I highly recommend it if you're looking for that sort of thing to change up your trip to Los Angeles and the Hollywood area, especially.

name: Wulong Tiankeng Three Bridges
description: Wulong was our very first stop in our 8-day Chongqing tour. Wulong's attractions are mainly natural scenery, and many are listed at World Natural Heritages. There are four main famous natural attractions in Wulong: the Three Natural Bridges, Furong Cave, Fairy Mountain, and Longshuixia Gap (龙水峡地缝). Our itinerary covered two of them, and our very first destination was this Three Natural Bridges (天生三桥).Nature travels fascinate people like me who are attuned to the hustle and bustle of a modern city life. In Hamlet, William Shakespeare articulated: There are more things in heaven than there are dreams in your philosophy.  At this Nature Three Bridges, it is a pristine world of calmness and peace and far from the madding crowd of our materialistic world. What the eyes see are the sculpture world of Nature: canyon, caves, looming mountain, sinkholes, emerald lakes, waterfalls; no concrete jungle, no polluted air or toxic noise that existed in our world.The Three Natural Bridges (天生三桥) is named as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2007. It became famous due to the filming of the Chinese film Curse of the Golden Flower (满城尽带黄金甲) and followed by the filming of Transformers 4: Age of Extinction The Director Michael Bay probably left the dinosaur autobot at the filming site for remembrance.The karst landscape is amazing and spectacular. The weather is cold, but I lost myself in the nature wonderland as I hiked for 2.5 km to discover the 3 bridges:  天龙桥; 青龙桥" and 黑龙桥. It was a bit challenging for the elderly before one reached the Black Dragon Bridge (黑龙桥) with some stairs to climb, but after this bridge, it is plain walking for the other two dragon bridges.When I hiked to Tianfu Postal House (天福驿站), I found it very photogenic. It looks different and unique with a Chinese architecture postal house surrounded by the karst landscape. I climbed up to a higher platform from the adjacent karst hill and took an iconic photo of this landmark. 天福驿站 was a transmission stop built during the Tang Dynasty for communication between two provinces.I was attracted by an emerald, green lake not far from the end of the trail. A small boat lies in the middle of the lake. The scenery looks very poetic, and in bitter cold winter, it would remind me of the Tang poem (江雪):千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。Our tour guide warned us that this trip covering the Three Bridges is just an appetizer, a warmup exercise. The more challenging hike will be at the Enshi Grand Canyon (恩施 大峡谷) which would be 3 times more challenging than this.Which would a be better hiking attraction: 天生三桥 or 恩施 大峡谷?

We have options for surf trips to local breaks nearby and Tamarindo surf camp packages for those looking to surf over a long weekend or week-long stay.

name: Priority Wine Pass & Wine Tours
description: Priority Wine Pass is a wine tasting card that you can purchase and use immediately. It give you a variety of offers including: 50% off tastings, complimentary tastings, complimentary elevated experiences, specials on food pairings and cave tours, discounts on wine, The Napa Wine Train, accommodations, transportation and more. We also build customized tasting agendas to help guide members.

name: Free Walking Tour Medellin - Real City Tours
description: The Free Walking Tour is based on tips. Walk around Medellin's downtown with a local. Explore the historic districts and let this fascinating city come to life through stories, descriptions and urban legends.﻿​ During 3.5 hours you will discover the most traditional squares and streets of the city. We will guide you through the history of Medellin, the culture and its people.

name: Fishing Excursions
description: I booked the 7 to 9 am fishing trip on a nitro to be picked up at the grand Floridian. Arrived at 6:30. Went to the boat launch and waited until 7:10. No boats or staff arrived, so I called and was advised that there was an issue with the boat and that they would be at the grand Floridian to pick me up shortly. At 7:30 I was still waiting and called again. This operator put me through to the grand Floridian boat launch and no one picked up. At 7:40 I approached the grand Floridian customer services. I advised the staff member of the situation and he called boat rental. The staff member advised me that the boat is currently on its way to the grand Floridian and if I had just been patient I would probably be on the boat right now. T thanked him and proceeded back to the boat launch. At 8:10 the boat still had not shown up so I called again. The operator was very helpful and after a while, she discovered that the boat believed I was at the contemporary. They did not find me there and went back to their base. The operator had guest service respond to my location to speak with me. Upon their arrival, they advised me that I would be refunded for my trip and I could still use the boat for the remaining half hour of my trip. When I agreed, they reached out and to boat rental and then advised that by the time the boat arrived, my time slot will have ended. They did not have any other time slots available to offer me. They promised me a refund, but provided me with no compensation for my lost time. Terrible experience and extremely disappointing for an avid fisherman such as myself.

name: Varenna Rent A Boat
description: Enjoy the Lake of Como, take a whole day or only few hours in one of the best place of Italy. Entrusted to Varenna Rent a Boat, with our boat you can reach and visit otherwise inaccessible coastal localities where nineteenth-century villas and pristine nature will make your browsing a genuine emotion. Rent to Boat in Varenna has never been so easy: car park a stone's throw from the mooring.

name: NYC Skyline Tours & Cruises
description: 60min Sightseeing Cruise on a yacht to see The Statue of Liberty With over 25 years experience creating unforgettable sightseeing memories for our guests, NYC Skyline Tours & Cruises offers guided cruises to view the Statue of Liberty, walking tours and full city tours in sprinter vans.

name: Doris Cruise
description:
Welcome to Doris Cruises
Dorise Cruises are two of the most luxurious 5- star yachts in Ha Long Bay and Lan Ha Bay- The symbol of the nature beauty in Vietnam.

It is a perfect blend of the sophistication between the classic European form and the rustic essence of Vietnamese styling. Doris Cruises itself creates the difference with the tiny distinguished feature from its elegant design, luxury.

name: Kronborg Slot
description: Kronborg is a must-see! “Hamlet’s Castle” is a magnificent experience with soaring towers, a huge ballroom, damp casemates and just 40 minutes from Copenhagen. At the narrowest neck of the sound, between Denmark and Sweden, the medieval fortress merges with the magnificent Renaissance castle and there are few sites in the world where so much drama and history is gathered in one place. Mythical hero Holger the Dane’s mighty sword meets Shakespeare’s equally mighty pen, as the spirit of Hamlet glides through the castle. No wonder this extraordinary place is on UNESCO’s World Heritage List.

name: Laguna El Dudu
description: Laguna Dudu is an exciting and mostly unknown paradise located on the north east coast of the Dominican Republic. It's surrounded by natural cliffs from which to swim, snorkel or free dive into refreshing clear waters. If you love adrenaline rush then try a zip line freefall from 10 meters. You may need to take a deep breath for this adventure. Once you finally takeoff for a subjective six seconds drop in thin air, and finish with a big splash. But it's also a spot worth visiting for it offers a cave to explore, a beautiful cove with other challenging experiences. There are stairs leading down to the water which enables smooth and easy access to both lagoons. With nature to explore and plenty of photographic spots. A visit to Laguna Dudu can easily be combined with two additional beach activities since it's located within minutes between two playas (beaches) Diamante and Arroyo Salado. Your next adventure awaits you. Come, explore and show us your favorite spot.

name: Thermopyles Hot Springs
description: We just stopped here for a short while, but did not actually swim in the spring. The water was comfortably warm (I felt it with my hand), but there is a strong odor of sulphur, which was not pleasant. There were several people swimming there when we visited -- kids and adults. They appeared to be locals. It was worth seeing, since we were already in the area, but I would not go out of my way to visit. Would I go swimming there? Maybe. But I would probably want to shower soon afterwards to wash off the malodorous sulphur-infused water.

name: Hospitalbar
description: Amsterdam’s buzzing hub, with its sprawling network of tram rails and a seemingly constant flow of tourists and commuters, yields convenient access to some of the best sightseeing, shopping, and street life in Europe. Closest at hand are the Royal Palace, the quaint shops of Haalremmerdijk, the pedestrianized zones Kalverstraat and Dam Square with popular neighborhoods such as the Red Light District, and the Canal Ring hardly more than a moment’s stroll away. With the well-connected Centraal Station as Centrum’s base, it's easy to travel farther afield via one of the city’s iconic trams.

name: Water Holes Canyon
description:
We saw one other tour group of 8-10 people while we were there for 3 hours. If you take photos, you will not have a bunch of other tourists bumping around, shoulder to shoulder, like at the more well-known slot canyons. No hipster instagram people or selfie takers clogging up the place. We were by ourselves for all but 10 minutes of the 3 hour tour!

On this three hour photo tour, we had Shane as our guide. He was extremely friendly and helpful and is also interested in photography. His whole attitude was relaxed and eager to help with getting photos the way you want them. He even played his Indian fluted inside one of the two slot canyon we went through. There was no feeling of being rushed.

This place is only 10 minutes outside of Page and is very convenient. Avoid the crowds and see a couple of beautiful slot canyons in peace.

name: Six Flags St Louis
description: Come experience Missouri's largest, most thrilling theme park filled with over 45 exciting rides, shows, & attractions!

name: VR Park Tokyo
description: There are countless opportunities to shop in the Shibuya and Harajuku districts, especially in shops that focus on Japan's "Kawaii" culture. The trendiest areas are around Shibuya’s Center district, Harajuku's Takeshita-dori and in Omotesando. If you need to recharge from all the shopping, you can easily refresh yourself in Meiji Jingu or Sasaki Park. In contrast, Ebisu has a more grown up ambiance of calm and cool. At the Museum of Yebisu Beer you can learn about the beer that was responsible for the town’s name, and enjoy dining at the popular noodle shops in the surrounding area.

name: Tiger Kingdom Phuket
description: Tiger Kingdom Phuket is a once in a lifetime experience where you can meet, play, and have your photo taken with tigers! Watch the tigers as you kick back with some food and drink from our top-quality restaurant. You are sure to have a very memorable experience! Open daily including public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

name: Rathaus
description: In Vienna's best-known district, pedestrian boulevards Kärntner Strasse and Graben connect you with landmarks such as the Wiener Staatsoper (Vienna State Opera), Vienna’s iconic Stephansdom (St. Stephen’s Cathedral) and the vast compound of Hofburg, the Habsburgs’ former Imperial Palace. Peek down side streets such as Annagasse and Weihburggasse, and Graben’s Seilergasse and Habsburggasse, to get a feel for the center. The Imperial Apartments and the refreshingly demystifying Sissi Museum are must-dos at Hofburg. Spacious squares such as Am Hof and Freyung often host beautiful seasonal and antiques markets.

name: California Science Center
description: Welcome to the California Science Center! While Endeavour is off exhibit, we remain one of the largest science centers in the nation, with multiple hands-on galleries, unforgettable special exhibitions, and immersive IMAX movies. General admission to our permanent exhibits is FREE. ( Excludes special paid exhibits and IMAX Theater.) The California Science Center is a dynamic destination where families, adults and children can explore the wonders of science through interactive exhibits, live demonstrations, innovative programs and awe-inspiring IMAX movies. The California Science Center and IMAX Theater are located in historic Exposition Park just west of the Harbor (110) Freeway at 700 Exposition Park Drive, Los Angeles. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day.

name: Blue Mosque
description: Built between 1609-1616, this impressive mosque has six minarets. Why is it called "Blue Mosque?" There are two stories: the first, more common one is that the interior is covered in Blue İznik tiles. The second is: many years ago, ancient sailors who sailed by the mosque on the Marmara Sea saw the blue colors of the sea reflected in the mosque.

name: Hanoi Old Quarter
categories: ['Beer Tastings & Tours in Hanoi', 'Cooking Classes in Hanoi', 'Food Tours in Hanoi', 'Breweries in Hanoi', 'Coffee & Tea Tours in Hanoi']
description: Located in the middle of Ha Noi, a rapidly developing city where changes take place every hour, Hanoi Old Quarter with its old-styled narrow streets full of antique brick houses seems to nostalgically resist the flow of time while still actively trying to adapt to the dynamic atmosphere of the modern city.

name: Arabella Cruise Bar
description: Discover the Arabella Cruise Bar: a floating monument, tested in WW2, with proven historical value. Get to know Thessaloniki from a different angle. Admire the incomparable beauty of the city, while enjoying your coffee. The beautiful sunset will fascinate you. Indulge in the rhythm of music accompanied by your loved ones, under the stars holding a unique cocktail. Arabella has been loved by the people, many events have taken place in it: such as its participation in those of the Ministry of Culture. with the theme of ancient ports in the Thermaic Gulf, photos for fashion magazines, video clips and countless receptions and parties. It makes 30-minute trips daily starting from the White Tower, heading to the commercial port and back. Its capacity is about 160 people. The ship is 25 meters long and 20 m high (14 m. Mast), while its draft is 2.8 meters.

name: Midland Railway
description: Midland Railroad is home of the Snowglobe Express Christmas Train that operates Mid November thru December 31. The Snowglobe Express is a one of a kind 12 mile round trip excursion where passengers ride in decorated vintage train cars to the Snowglobe Christmas Village, where they get off the train and spend 45- 60 minutes. The village is a magical world where they can enjoy Christmas music, amazing lighting, roasting s'mores, and see live reindeer. children also have the opportunity to visit Santa and deliver their letters to his Elf aboard our over the top decorated U.S. Postal vintage mail car. Food and drink are also available for purchase. The train operates on a line that was originally constructed in 1867. Midland Railroad also offers train rides at various times through out the year, with other event type trains.

name: Bigfoot Discovery Expedition
description: My family did the Bigfoot Discovery Expedition July 2021.  Everyone had a good time until the end.  Loved feeding the cows and looking at the scenery.  We do not see how the ending fit with finding Bigfoot.The truck drove into a building, the lights were turned out, a foggy mist was released and hot air blown at you from what felt like a heat lamp that was turned on high. In addition to this, monitors played a scene from a drug raid with people kneeling to be executed.  There was shouting, shooting and bombs going off.  It was extremely violent.  This lasted 10-15 minutes.  ave gonWe had a 6 and 8 year old with us who got scared.  Unfortunately we didn't read other reviews under the Big Foot Fun Park that mentioned this ending and were not provided this information prior to purchasing tickets and boarding the truck. If we had, we would not have gone.It totally ruined the fun we had been having. Prior to this, I said I’d do it again with another family member.  After sitting through the end, none of us will go back.If they want to continue with this violent ending, I suggest giving participants the choice of sitting through this ordeal or choosing a fun ending that’s actually related to Big Foot.  Even if it’s just seeing some Big Foot cutouts/statues, that would have been preferable.

name: Sandland Adventures
description: Experience the Oregon Dunes and Family Fun Park at Sandland Adventures. Offering tours of the dunes since 1987, our professional drivers will show you a great time while you travel across an impressive natural wonder of endless shifting sand. Choose an exhilarating dune ride on our Sandrails or a relaxing tour on our Giant Dune Buggies. For those who prefer speed and excitement, try either a half hour 10 mile tour or an hour 20 mile tour. These 7 to 10 passenger Long Travel Sandrails have over 20” of suspension travel and plenty of horsepower to take you on an exhilarating ride. If you prefer a slower pace, enjoy our Giant Dune Buggy Tour with many picture opportunities. Informative, scenic and fun describes this one hour dune buggy tour covering approximately 8 miles of dunes and 2 miles of ocean beach. Climbing and descending through the most beautiful, impressive dunes will be an unforgettable experience. We are located less than one mile south of Florence on Hwy 101.

name: Canarias.com
description:
Canarias.com is the brand that groups together different tourist businesses in Tenerife. with more than 40 years of experience and a team of more than 100 professionals. Our services include:
- Transfers with driver in high-end vehicles: sedans, limousines, vans. All high-end vehicles driven by multilingual chauffeurs.
- Vehicle rental with more than 20 collection and delivery points

name: Kapadokya Balloons
description: Kapadokya Balloons is celebrating 32 successful year! As the people who pioneered ballooning in Cappadocia, we share your love for adventure. It's that passion, tempered with more than twenty five years of experience flying balloons that has helped us become the best ballooning operator in Turkey. Every flight is a fantastic adventure as we float intimately amongst the fairy chimneys and soar over the magnificent Cappadocian landscape. A flight with Kapadokya Balloons is truly "the experience of a lifetime!"

name: La Gondola
description: Experience Providence from a new perspective! Benvenuto! We invite you to revel in the sights of the City from a unique vantage point that captures the heart of Providence. Enjoy an excursion along the Woonasquatucket and Providence Rivers and witness the revitalization of the City, river walks, and waterfront parks. Whether you are celebrating an anniversary or birthday, looking to propose to that special someone, or just on a vacation to the city, a gondola trip is a great way to make your visit to Providence memorable and unique. La Gondola operates three authentic Venetian gondolas along the Providence Riverwalk, accommodating up to six passengers at a time on each gondola. Reservations are highly recommended and are always exclusive to your party. We are open seven days a week from 9 a.m. to 11 p.m. Our season is from 1 May to 31 October, and of course trips are always subject to availability and the weather. La Gondola Providence: For Lovers, For Families, For Everyone.

name: Go City | Dubai
description: Enjoy incredible savings on top Dubai attractions and tours with Go City. There's different activities to suit everyone - all hand-picked by our team of local experts. Discover as many as 45 activities from skyscraper heights to desert delights. Available as an instant digital pass with the free Go City app. Includes At The Top - Burj Khalifa, Aquaventure Waterpark at Atlantis the Palm, and more.

name: Bateaux Parisiens
description: Bateaux Parisiens offers Cruise Tours, Lunch Cruises and Dinner Cruises. Aboard an entirely glass-encased boat, you'll be in on the secret of the city of lights. The cuisine is meticulously presented, the service is attentive and discreet, your eyes will sparkle as never before... This is a must-do, a cultural and very Parisian experience that is unique and must be shared!

name: Fourth Ward
description: Beautiful hidden gem of a neighborhood in Uptown Charlotte. I recommend downloading the Friends of Fourth Ward walking tour. We were a bit disappointed that some homes had been painted more boring whites and greys since the last time we visited a few years ago. They have lost some of their Victorian charm, but at least they are still standing.

name: Great River Road
description: Part of a 3,000-mile network of roads called the Great River Road National Scenic Byway, Wisconsin's Great River Road is made up of several highways covering about 300 miles from Kieler in the state's southwestern corner to St. Croix Falls, about an hour northeast of Minneapolis-St. Paul.

name: Medellin Metrocable
description: The Metrocable is a gondola lift that links the city center with the surrounding hillside communities. More than just an efficient mode of transportation, it is also a convenient and affordable way to see Medellin, offering breathtaking views of the city and surrounding countryside. Your regular metro ticket covers the cost of the 30-minute ride, and you can take the trip multiple times as long as you do not exit the station. The hilltop residents make their daily commute on the Metrocable so it can get busy during peak hours. And take note of the timing of the last car from the top. – Tripadvisor

name: Cala Del Moraig
description: Se trata de una playa de ensueño, donde arena y grava crean un mosaico bajo el sol. Esta playa de arena blancas tiene aguas tan claras que te invitan a explorar el silencio del Mediterráneo. Este lugar se llama Cala Moraig. Es un tesoro en la Costa Blanca, escondida detrás del macizo del puig llorença perfecto para quienes buscan experiencias únicas como el submarinismo. Cala del moraig se encuentra en Benitatxell, entre Xàbia y Moraira, esta playa une aventura, relax y amor por la naturaleza.

name: Club Roxy Prague
description: Roxy is one of Prague's oldest and best-known clubs, and over the years has attracted big name DJ's as well as bands. The slightly dilapidated interior and big open spaces gives Roxy more of a warehouse feel than a modern club, the rawness of it fitting the style of music. The dance floor is large, and there is cool lighting and video projections. You need to experience this!

name: Theresienwiese
description: This huge grassy park annually hosts the city's popular Oktoberfest.

name: Valdanos Beach
description: The area is beautiful.But: garbage lies everywhere, the area is full of unsightly construction ruins. The payment area is huge, the free area small.Nobody cares about the ambience. It's a shame.Can't recommend it.

name: Grand Teton
description: Tallest mountain in the Grand Teton Range.

name: Burriana Beach
description:
Burriana Beach can be a challenge for anyone who has problems walking - not when you are down on the promenade but walking down the hill(and back up again) can take a real effort.  There is limited parking near the sea front but a multi story a little further behind the main area.

Once on the promenade the beach area is flat and backed by a number of bars restaurants and shops (with parking if you are lucky to get a space) so it makes for a pleasant walk.  The beach itself is made up of sand and small gravel/pebbles and is well sheltered so waves are not too high in normal conditions.  There are areas where you can hire sunbeds and umbrellas or bring some beach chairs and a cheap beach umbrella for a picnic.

On an evening around about 6 to 7pm I noticed more parking spaces on the street behind the promenade if you intend to eat there.

name: Space Needle
description: Located in the Lower Queen Anne neighborhood, this iconic landmark and observation tower was built for the 1962 World’s Fair. Perch on the glass benches known as “Skyrisers” and gaze out of floor-to-ceiling windows, snap a selfie at the outdoor deck, or head upstairs to The Loupe, an indoor lounge featuring the world’s first and only rotating glass floor. Here, you’ll be greeted with 360-degree views of the downtown Seattle skyline, Mount Rainier, Elliot Bay, and the Olympic and Cascade Mountains. For a smooth-sailing experience, it’s best to pre-purchase a timed ticket. Space Needle is also a part of CityPASS. – Tripadvisor

name: Top Omo Valley Tours
description: Top Omo Valley Tours is a locally owned Ethiopian tribal tour operator based in Jinka, right at the heart of the Omo Valley region in Southern Ethiopia. Book authentic Omo Valley tours from Addis Ababa, from Jinka, or from Arba Minch and immerse yourself in the unique cultures of the Omo Valley tribes. Travel with the #1 local Omo Valley tour operator and travel company in Ethiopia.

name: SXM St Martin Catamaran Charters
description: 48 feet luxury catamaran 2 to 15 People. Private cruise ship tours; Shared cruise ship tours; SXM day tours; SXM excursions; Private day charters. ITINERARIES: Tintamarre, Pinel Island, Spot airplanes Maho Beach; St Barth, Fourche Island, Anguilla, Prickly Pear & more. SXM day charters, SXM boat charters; SXM catamarans charters; SXM private yacht charters. Breakfast, Gourmet lunch (Appetizers, 3 courses & Cheeses) on board & open bar included. Snorkelling gears, fishing gears, 2 paddle boards included.

name: Mari Mari Cultural Village
description: The village is located about 25 minutes away from the city. The journey will take you to long roads surrounded by a rich spectrum of greenery and over arched by wild blue skies. In the village, the colors of cultural diversity are not an issue but rather our pride, where you can savor the soul of Sabah. Upon arrival at the entrance of the village, you will be ushered to the warmth of different homes of the ethnicity of Sabah. Each home was built by descendants of the tribes they represent and offer you a truly genuine experience seeing everything in and around the village lends to its magical prowess of taking you back in time. Not only does this village portray these tribes (5 tribes) through the architectural genius of their traditional houses, but also through a range of simulated lives of the olden epoch by the residents of the village. Acquaint yourself with each tribe as they let you come into their house and their simple yet intricate lives. As you traverse the village, you will find demonstration huts along the main houses in which daily activities of old times come into life. For example, the making of blowpipe, starting a fire (from bamboo), tattoo-making (and its symbolisms) and etc. By the end of your journey into the past, you have been given a setting for you to see, hear, taste and feel the uniqueness of what Sabah truly is. An unforgettable encounter of our Sabahan homeland... AS IT IS... AS IT WAS...

name: Rome Shuttle Limousine
description: Rome Shuttle Limousine offers a transfer service to and from the airports and the Port in Rome. name: Zipline Dolinka
description: Zipline Dolinka will take you on a journey over protected valley of Sava Dolinka, located only a few minutes from Lake Bled . Seven ziplines will bring you on a unique outdoor experience, where you can explore, learn about the nature and enjoy fresh air. Our guides will tell you the story about the valley that the locals worked so hard to preserve, and you'll see the beauty of it during the flights.

description: We are the locals & official Dune Buggy Tours Operator from DTCM. We have latest dunes buggies, Can-Am, Polaris, Yamaha & Many more. Since 2000 we are the number one in this business & have served millions of clients in the time period. People come as guest leaves as family member from here. Discover the beauty of desert with our locals & make your trip unforgetable.

name: St. Kitts Scenic Railway
description: The narrow gauge St. Kitts scenic railway is one of the most beautiful train rides in the world. Originally built in 1912 to deliver sugarcane from the fields to the sugar mill in Basseterre, the "Last Railway in the West Indies" now provides a fascinating way for visitors to see the island from the comfort of modern passenger train cars and sightseeing buses. The railway hugs the Northeastern coastline where spectacular vistas of ocean, surf, cliffs, and lush vegetation surround you. The train rolls across tall steel bridges spanning deep ""ghuts"", or canyons, and winds through small villages and farms. Dark green rainforests are skirted by rippling fields of sugar can, with the volcanic cone of Mt. Liamuiga rising above the railway. This unique rail and highway experience allows visitors the opportunity to see the island in a very short period of time. Your guide will point out all the sights as the train passes old sugar estates with abandoned windmills and chimneys.

name: Revolution Rail Co.
description: Railbiking with Revolution Rail Co. is a fun excursion activity that allows riders to ride the railroad tracks under their own power and explore Cape May in a brand new way! In partnership with Cape May Seashore Lines, our Cape May Run is a 4-mile out-and-back trip alongside the The Nature Conservancy’s Garrett Family Preserve. Be sure to allot about 1.5 hrs for this fun and educational tour.

name: On The Go Tours
description: From Egypt to India and Japan to Morocco, we love helping you see the world your way, unlocking the finest sights and experiences the world has to offer with our range of group tours and Tailor-made holidays. Immerse yourself in a truly authentic local experience on one of our popular guided group tours which are a great choice for single travellers too, make a date with some of the world's most colourful festivals, take an unforgettable family adventure, or tailor-make that dream holiday,

name: Nickerson State Park
description: We did the approximately 3-mile LOVELY Cliff Pond Trail. We also paid $30 for parking as non Massachusetts residents and got covered in ticks. We sprayed ourselves with tick repellent before we began the hike and stayed on the well-maintained trail. Because of our precautions, we were absolutely shocked when we found 6 ticks on us when we got back to the parking lot. We were planning on driving over to another part of the park to do a second hike to at least get our parking money's worth. However, all those ticks were quite off-putting and we decided to leave the park instead.

description: Nice boardwalk that offers good views of downtown.  Easy to walk, run or bike on.  Only complaint is that there is a ton of trash along the shores near the boardwalk.

description: Catalina Island Company offers land and sea tours including the top-rated Zip Line Eco Tour, brand new Catalina Aerial Adventure, Cape Canyon Expedition, East End Adventure, Inland Expedition, Avalon Scenic Tour, Skyline Drive, Ocean Runner, Flying Fish Tour, Undersea Expedition and Glass Bottom Boat. Other venues include Descanso Beach Club and Island Spa Catalina.

name: Don Juan Tours
description: Don Juan Tours Monteverde is a family business that, through its tours, teaches visitors the entire process behind three very important products worldwide, Coffee, Chocolate and Sugar Cane. On this Coffee, Chocolate and Sugar Cane Tour, you will know the whole process of Coffee, from the seed to the delicious cup of coffee. Once the coffee tour is finished, we will start with the sweetest part of the tour, the delicious Chocolate. Like coffee, we will talk from the seed to the delicious Chocolate bar and we will end up selecting some members of the group to grind the Cacao and make some chocolate. Once finished you will have the opportunity to taste several types of chocolate such as Dark Chocolate, Milk Chocolate and White Chocolate. description:
Verneus is a company created by travelers and destined to offer the best tours and experiences.

name: Indiana Dunes State Park
description: Indiana Dunes State Park consists of 2,182 acres of primitive, beautiful, historic and unique Hoosier landscape. It lies at the north end of State Road 49 in Porter County, and includes more than three miles of beautiful beach along Lake Michigan’s southern shore. In the early 1900s scientists, recreationists and nature enthusiasts, recognizing the value and potential of the Indiana dunes area, fought to have the region preserved. As a result, in 1925, the state park was established.Large sand dunes, located beyond the entire shoreline, have taken thousands of years to form, and tower nearly 200 feet above Lake Michigan. A wide range of habitats and plant species are found in the park, with vegetation stabilizing some of the sand. These habitats provide homes for many types of plants and animals. The lake also provides habitat for many aquatic species, as well as a constantly changing fishery.Indiana Dunes State Park features a wide variety of habitats, including beach, sand dunes, black oak forest, wooded wetlands, and a button-bush marsh. Together, these areas contain some of the most diverse flora and fauna in the Midwest. Botanists from across the country enjoy studying the unusual collection of plant life. Other interesting features include “tree graveyards” (places where forests have been buried by sand and then, more recently, re-exposed by wind erosion). “Tree graveyards” can be seen in Big Blowout, near Trail 10. The Indiana Dunes area also is renowned throughout the Midwest for its birding. Visit the Nature Center to ask about good birding locations.Indiana Dunes State Park is surrounded by Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore, a federally administered park comprising approximately 15,000 acres.

name: Playa La Pared
description: This is a beautiful beach that is popular with surfers, but people really underestimate the danger here.  There are significant rip currents and no life guards.  Yesterday a 26 year old tourist was lost in a rip current and we watched the coast guard and local rescue teams search for hours to no avail.  Just last week another adult male tourist drowned shortly after a surfing lesson.  You really need to know what you’re doing to swim or surf at a beach like this.

name: Reading Terminal Market

name: Shri Trimbakeshwar Temple
description:
Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple:

Located in the picturesque town of Trimbak, Maharashtra, the Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple is a revered and sacred site dedicated to Lord Shiva. It is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, which makes it an immensely significant pilgrimage destination for Hindus.

The temple is set against the backdrop of the Sahyadri mountain range, offering visitors a serene and peaceful environment. The temple complex is beautifully constructed with intricate carvings and a rich architectural style that reflects ancient Hindu temple designs. The main sanctum houses the Trimbakeshwar Shivling, which is unique because it has three faces representing Lord Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. This distinctive feature adds to the temple's spiritual importance.

The temple is not just an architectural marvel but is also surrounded by a tranquil atmosphere, making it a place for reflection and prayer. Visitors can also take a holy dip in the nearby Brahmagiri River, which is believed to purify one’s soul. The temple is located close to the source of the Godavari River, adding to its spiritual significance.

The priests and staff at the temple are warm and helpful, guiding pilgrims through the rituals and offering a complete spiritual experience. The temple is usually crowded, especially during festivals like Mahashivaratri, so planning a visit during less busy times could provide a more peaceful experience.

One unique ritual at the temple is the "Trimbak" puja, which is performed to seek blessings for health, wealth, and prosperity. It is a must-visit for those seeking divine blessings or exploring India's rich spiritual heritage.

Conclusion:
The Trimbakeshwar Mahadev Temple is not just a place of worship but a sacred site brimming with history, spiritual significance, and natural beauty. Its peaceful surroundings, combined with the deep spiritual energy, make it a must-visit for devotees and travelers alike.

name: Lake Hollywood Park
description:
I lived in Los Angeles in the 90's and visit often because I have a daughter who lives in Hollywood, and I never knew this gem was here until I searched for running paths on my last visit! I was looking for a relatively flat trail since I'm from Houston, which is very flat. I drove up here, and the parking area is only about 12 minutes from Hollywood Blvd. and La Brea, where I was coming from. It feels a world away from the city below! The reservoir is a beautiful blue lake with wildlife you will easily see, including donkey deer, rabbits, and water birds. The Hollywood sign is just above the park and loop, and you will see it easily and unobstructed from parts of the path.

The loop around the reservoir is 3.3 miles, so the whole thing should be doable for those looking to run a 5k or continuing training for one, as I was. It's also a walking trail that probably takes an hour to an hour and a half to complete, depending upon your walking pace. Of course, you can also visit and only walk as far as you like, turning around to retrace your steps when you want to be halfway done.

Using GPS, put in Lake Hollywood Reservoir to get to the parking area for the trail. I used the 6381 Weidlake Dr address to a free parking area and trail entrance, although I saw there are supposed to be other entrances on Lake Hollywood Drive and Wonder View Drive.

The experience is really wonderful with incredible views of the city below, the water and wildlife, and the Hollywood sign, not to mention the pretty drive up through the Hollywood Hills to get there. I highly recommend it if you're looking for that sort of thing to change up your trip to Los Angeles and the Hollywood area, especially.

name: Wadi Shab
description:
I read a lot of reviews and appreciated the ones with tips so I will pass along my own.  

I drove myself, it’s completely doable, you don’t need to spend $$$ on a tour.  The country is very drivable.  I arrived around 11 and the parking under the bridge was full but I still found a spot with no issues. 

There’s a store/cafe near the boat ramp selling drinks and it appeared light food. I was happy to grab an extra water before the start. 

As many people said, 1 rial for the boat, kids are free.  There was a man renting life vests, selling various size wet bags, water shoes and phone dry bags.  I bought a phone dry case(3 rial)  but didn’t use it for fear it would leak and then I’d be without a phone to get back.  

We were wearing sneakers, I’ve traveled all over the world, backpacked years ago and have never need water shoes before.  For this trip if I did it again I would get the shoes.  It was about 4 minutes total (there and back) over rocks if you want to get to the cave and we did it but my feet were sore the next day.  

It was 1.90 miles one way and took myself and an active 6 year old 1 hour to get to the main event.  We wore our suits and took a backpack.  I saw the full spectrum of people, young adults in flip flops, serious hikers in full hiking boots and gear, a couple with an infant carrying dad and the mom with a toddler on her hip, elder people being assisted.  The hike isn’t hard but it’s slippery and there are times when you need 3 points of contact (feet, hands, rear) and there are points where it’s close to the edge with a narrow walk way.  We had to cross over water once on the way there. 

It’s about 10 minutes of swim, walk, swim to the cave and in late December the space was just large enough to fit a medium size adult head, you could go under and make it as well. Many adults opted not to try but it was pretty awesome when we get in.  There wasn’t many places on the way or in the cave to hold on too so if you are not a strong swimmer, then take the life vest.  

Totally worth a visit!

name: Piazza Tasso
description:
The Piazzoa Tasso sits at the centre of the town of Sorrento. If not at the exact geographic centre of this tourist town on the Sorrentine Peninsula south of Naples, then certainly close enough. It could however be considered the cultural and economic centre of Sorrento.

It is the start point for the Corso Italian, one of the main thoroughfares of the town that begins at its eastern edge. To the north down a steep cliff is the Marina Picollo one of the two harbours in the town and the terminus for the numerous ferries that ply the Bay of Naples. 

South is the tree lined Viale Enrico Caruso, and to the east of this is the Sorrento train station the terminus for the commuter train that runs to Pompeii and Naples and a transit hub for local and regional buses. Finally, to the west lies the Via San Cesareo a pedestrian only street that is the heart of the Centro Storico a tourist zone of narrow streets full of shops and attractions.

The Piazza Tasso was named after the 16th Century poet Torqueto Tasso (1544-1595) who was born in Sorrento.  A statue honouring him stands in the plaza off to the side. In the centre of the plaza stands another statue. This one dedicated to Sant Antonio or Antoninus of Sorrento the patron Saint of Sorrento. This is one of two statues to the Saint in the town, the other is in the centre of the nearby Piazza Sant’ Antonio.

On the north eastern edge of the plaza is the Santuario della Madonna del Carmine a 15th Century Church.  West of this covering the northern edge is the narrow gorge that bisects the town and leads to the seaside and port. The Via Luigi de Maio winds through this as does a series of steep steps.

The rest of the Piazza is lined with several cafes and restaurants where one may grab a meal or just a drink and kill some time people watching. It should be noted that these for the most part cater to the crowds of tourists and are priced accordingly.

If so, Parasailing is the perfect thing for you! Increase the fun factor and fly together with your friends or family all together above the Croatian Adriatic Sea at the famous beach of Makarska! I did section A and took me around 3 hrs. (only 1.75 miles one way including stopped a few time for taking a photo). name: Soi Rambuttri
description: The Riverside neighborhood in Bangkok paints a picture of serene beauty, with its majestic, glittering temples and iconic long-tail boats sailing along the Chao Phraya River. Spectacular landmarks, like the Grand Palace and Wat Arun, are a sight to behold, reflecting the city's rich history and vibrant culture. Here, culinary exploration is a must, with a plethora of riverside eateries and floating markets offering a delightful gastronomic experience. description: Santa Monica is a coastal town that maintains a balance as a tourist destination and as an area with a thriving local culture. On the beach, bikers, roller-bladers, runners and walkers move along the famed bike path enjoying the beautiful Los Angeles weather. The solar-powered Ferris wheel at the Santa Monica pier spins high above the water, while park revelers scream with delight riding the roller coaster. name: Gyermekvasút
description: Trains run every day of the year (including public holidays: Christmas, Easter, etc), the only exception are Mondays from the beginning of September to the end of April. Children’s Railway, Budapest is one of Budapest’s most unique attractions. Like any other railway, it has ticket offices, diesel locomotives, signals, switches and a timetable. Unlike other railways though, this one is run by children. The line stretches among the Buda hills from Széchenyihegy to Hűvösvölgy, crossing the Cogwheel Railway and serving Normafa as well as the highest point of Budapest: Jánoshegy. It is the world's largest Children's Railway. The lookout towers, forest playgrounds, places of pilgrimage and other attractions lie close to the stations, making the Children’s Railway the ideal jumping-off point for a half-day trip even for families, friends, groups or lonely. The journey between terminals takes approximately 40-50 minutes. On some days our steam locomotive is also operating.

name: Sun Moon Lake Ropeway

name: Harding Ice Field Trail
description: Wow, just wow! The whole way up you get stunning views of the mountains, the valley, and eventually Exit Glacier.My parents wanted to go slower, so they went about 1/3 of the way up to Marmot Meadows, which has great views and the first view of the glacier.We only went up to Top of the Cliffs (magnificent views!), with the end of the trail & views of the Harding Icefield about 0.9 miles further.The hike was moderately hard, with pretty much the entire way up being uphill, and pretty steep at times. We are in good shape, and it definitely got our hearts pumping! We encountered bear scat, but didn't see any wildlife. Don't forget to bring a warm jacket because the higher you get, the colder it gets!

name: Los Cahorros
description:
We went to do this family activity with our 14-year-old. We are not great sportsmen we left in the morning to avoid the strong heat: the path begins in the heights of Monachil next to a restaurant called “El puntarron” where there is a parking point for the vehicle. Then on your left is the start of the route on a private road with several houses. 
We took the path “Los Cahorros Bajos” with a shaded beginning of the waterfalls of the monkey bridges it is really beautiful and nice not big difficulties to do it with family then you arrive at a point where there are 2 paths which one to take? Some hikers took a left where there is a monkey bridge others straight to the mountains! It lacks signs on the course especially here! 
We went straight into the mountains where the route is a more complicated especially with young children but the view of the mountains is sublime. We made a nice loop and we returned well to the Check-out point we did about 10 km in just over 3 hours walking quietly and without break except to drink water from time to time! 
Provide good shoes, water is hot in the mountains (no wind) enough to eat a little bit and why not a small towel if you want to soak your feet in the many waterfalls present!

name: Wulong Tiankeng Three Bridges
description: Wulong was our very first stop in our 8-day Chongqing tour. Wulong's attractions are mainly natural scenery, and many are listed at World Natural Heritages. There are four main famous natural attractions in Wulong: the Three Natural Bridges, Furong Cave, Fairy Mountain, and Longshuixia Gap (龙水峡地缝). Our itinerary covered two of them, and our very first destination was this Three Natural Bridges (天生三桥).Nature travels fascinate people like me who are attuned to the hustle and bustle of a modern city life. In Hamlet, William Shakespeare articulated: There are more things in heaven than there are dreams in your philosophy.  At this Nature Three Bridges, it is a pristine world of calmness and peace and far from the madding crowd of our materialistic world. What the eyes see are the sculpture world of Nature: canyon, caves, looming mountain, sinkholes, emerald lakes, waterfalls; no concrete jungle, no polluted air or toxic noise that existed in our world.The Three Natural Bridges (天生三桥) is named as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2007. It became famous due to the filming of the Chinese film Curse of the Golden Flower (满城尽带黄金甲) and followed by the filming of Transformers 4: Age of Extinction The Director Michael Bay probably left the dinosaur autobot at the filming site for remembrance.The karst landscape is amazing and spectacular. The weather is cold, but I lost myself in the nature wonderland as I hiked for 2.5 km to discover the 3 bridges:  天龙桥; 青龙桥" and 黑龙桥. It was a bit challenging for the elderly before one reached the Black Dragon Bridge (黑龙桥) with some stairs to climb, but after this bridge, it is plain walking for the other two dragon bridges.When I hiked to Tianfu Postal House (天福驿站), I found it very photogenic. It looks different and unique with a Chinese architecture postal house surrounded by the karst landscape. I climbed up to a higher platform from the adjacent karst hill and took an iconic photo of this landmark. 天福驿站 was a transmission stop built during the Tang Dynasty for communication between two provinces.I was attracted by an emerald, green lake not far from the end of the trail. A small boat lies in the middle of the lake. The scenery looks very poetic, and in bitter cold winter, it would remind me of the Tang poem (江雪):千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭。孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪。Our tour guide warned us that this trip covering the Three Bridges is just an appetizer, a warmup exercise. The more challenging hike will be at the Enshi Grand Canyon (恩施 大峡谷) which would be 3 times more challenging than this.Which would a be better hiking attraction: 天生三桥 or 恩施 大峡谷?

name: Fishing Excursions
description: I booked the 7 to 9 am fishing trip on a nitro to be picked up at the grand Floridian. Arrived at 6:30. Went to the boat launch and waited until 7:10. No boats or staff arrived, so I called and was advised that there was an issue with the boat and that they would be at the grand Floridian to pick me up shortly. At 7:30 I was still waiting and called again. This operator put me through to the grand Floridian boat launch and no one picked up. At 7:40 I approached the grand Floridian customer services. I advised the staff member of the situation and he called boat rental. The staff member advised me that the boat is currently on its way to the grand Floridian and if I had just been patient I would probably be on the boat right now. T thanked him and proceeded back to the boat launch. At 8:10 the boat still had not shown up so I called again. The operator was very helpful and after a while, she discovered that the boat believed I was at the contemporary. They did not find me there and went back to their base. The operator had guest service respond to my location to speak with me. Upon their arrival, they advised me that I would be refunded for my trip and I could still use the boat for the remaining half hour of my trip. When I agreed, they reached out and to boat rental and then advised that by the time the boat arrived, my time slot will have ended. They did not have any other time slots available to offer me. They promised me a refund, but provided me with no compensation for my lost time. Terrible experience and extremely disappointing for an avid fisherman such as myself.
