name: Kronborg Slot
description: Kronborg is a must-see! “Hamlet’s Castle” is a magnificent experience with soaring towers, a huge ballroom, damp casemates and just 40 minutes from Copenhagen. At the narrowest neck of the sound, between Denmark and Sweden, the medieval fortress merges with the magnificent Renaissance castle and there are few sites in the world where so much drama and history is gathered in one place. Mythical hero Holger the Dane’s mighty sword meets Shakespeare’s equally mighty pen, as the spirit of Hamlet glides through the castle. No wonder this extraordinary place is on UNESCO’s World Heritage List.

name: Laguna El Dudu
description: Laguna Dudu is an exciting and mostly unknown paradise located on the north east coast of the Dominican Republic. It's surrounded by natural cliffs from which to swim, snorkel or free dive into refreshing clear waters. If you love adrenaline rush then try a zip line freefall from 10 meters. You may need to take a deep breath for this adventure. Once you finally takeoff for a subjective six seconds drop in thin air, and finish with a big splash. But it's also a spot worth visiting for it offers a cave to explore, a beautiful cove with other challenging experiences. There are stairs leading down to the water which enables smooth and easy access to both lagoons. With nature to explore and plenty of photographic spots. A visit to Laguna Dudu can easily be combined with two additional beach activities since it's located within minutes between two playas (beaches) Diamante and Arroyo Salado. Your next adventure awaits you. Come, explore and show us your favorite spot.

name: Thermopyles Hot Springs
description: We just stopped here for a short while, but did not actually swim in the spring. The water was comfortably warm (I felt it with my hand), but there is a strong odor of sulphur, which was not pleasant. There were several people swimming there when we visited -- kids and adults. They appeared to be locals. It was worth seeing, since we were already in the area, but I would not go out of my way to visit. Would I go swimming there? Maybe. But I would probably want to shower soon afterwards to wash off the malodorous sulphur-infused water.

name: Hospitalbar
description: Amsterdam’s buzzing hub, with its sprawling network of tram rails and a seemingly constant flow of tourists and commuters, yields convenient access to some of the best sightseeing, shopping, and street life in Europe. Closest at hand are the Royal Palace, the quaint shops of Haalremmerdijk, the pedestrianized zones Kalverstraat and Dam Square with popular neighborhoods such as the Red Light District, and the Canal Ring hardly more than a moment’s stroll away. With the well-connected Centraal Station as Centrum’s base, it's easy to travel farther afield via one of the city’s iconic trams.

name: Water Holes Canyon
description:
We saw one other tour group of 8-10 people while we were there for 3 hours. If you take photos, you will not have a bunch of other tourists bumping around, shoulder to shoulder, like at the more well-known slot canyons. No hipster instagram people or selfie takers clogging up the place. We were by ourselves for all but 10 minutes of the 3 hour tour!

On this three hour photo tour, we had Shane as our guide. He was extremely friendly and helpful and is also interested in photography. His whole attitude was relaxed and eager to help with getting photos the way you want them. He even played his Indian fluted inside one of the two slot canyon we went through. There was no feeling of being rushed.

This place is only 10 minutes outside of Page and is very convenient. Avoid the crowds and see a couple of beautiful slot canyons in peace.

name: Six Flags St Louis
description: Come experience Missouri's largest, most thrilling theme park filled with over 45 exciting rides, shows, & attractions!

name: VR Park Tokyo
description: There are countless opportunities to shop in the Shibuya and Harajuku districts, especially in shops that focus on Japan's "Kawaii" culture. The trendiest areas are around Shibuya’s Center district, Harajuku's Takeshita-dori and in Omotesando. If you need to recharge from all the shopping, you can easily refresh yourself in Meiji Jingu or Sasaki Park. In contrast, Ebisu has a more grown up ambiance of calm and cool. At the Museum of Yebisu Beer you can learn about the beer that was responsible for the town’s name, and enjoy dining at the popular noodle shops in the surrounding area.

name: Tiger Kingdom Phuket
description: Tiger Kingdom Phuket is a once in a lifetime experience where you can meet, play, and have your photo taken with tigers! Watch the tigers as you kick back with some food and drink from our top-quality restaurant. You are sure to have a very memorable experience! Open daily including public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

name: Rathaus
description: In Vienna's best-known district, pedestrian boulevards Kärntner Strasse and Graben connect you with landmarks such as the Wiener Staatsoper (Vienna State Opera), Vienna’s iconic Stephansdom (St. Stephen’s Cathedral) and the vast compound of Hofburg, the Habsburgs’ former Imperial Palace. Peek down side streets such as Annagasse and Weihburggasse, and Graben’s Seilergasse and Habsburggasse, to get a feel for the center. The Imperial Apartments and the refreshingly demystifying Sissi Museum are must-dos at Hofburg. Spacious squares such as Am Hof and Freyung often host beautiful seasonal and antiques markets.

name: California Science Center
description: Welcome to the California Science Center! While Endeavour is off exhibit, we remain one of the largest science centers in the nation, with multiple hands-on galleries, unforgettable special exhibitions, and immersive IMAX movies. General admission to our permanent exhibits is FREE. ( Excludes special paid exhibits and IMAX Theater.) The California Science Center is a dynamic destination where families, adults and children can explore the wonders of science through interactive exhibits, live demonstrations, innovative programs and awe-inspiring IMAX movies. The California Science Center and IMAX Theater are located in historic Exposition Park just west of the Harbor (110) Freeway at 700 Exposition Park Drive, Los Angeles. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's Day.

name: Blue Mosque
description: Built between 1609-1616, this impressive mosque has six minarets. Why is it called "Blue Mosque?" There are two stories: the first, more common one is that the interior is covered in Blue İznik tiles. The second is: many years ago, ancient sailors who sailed by the mosque on the Marmara Sea saw the blue colors of the sea reflected in the mosque.

name: Hanoi Old Quarter
categories: ['Beer Tastings & Tours in Hanoi', 'Cooking Classes in Hanoi', 'Food Tours in Hanoi', 'Breweries in Hanoi', 'Coffee & Tea Tours in Hanoi']
description: Located in the middle of Ha Noi, a rapidly developing city where changes take place every hour, Hanoi Old Quarter with its old-styled narrow streets full of antique brick houses seems to nostalgically resist the flow of time while still actively trying to adapt to the dynamic atmosphere of the modern city.

name: Arabella Cruise Bar
description: Discover the Arabella Cruise Bar: a floating monument, tested in WW2, with proven historical value. Get to know Thessaloniki from a different angle. Admire the incomparable beauty of the city, while enjoying your coffee. The beautiful sunset will fascinate you. Indulge in the rhythm of music accompanied by your loved ones, under the stars holding a unique cocktail. Arabella has been loved by the people, many events have taken place in it: such as its participation in those of the Ministry of Culture. with the theme of ancient ports in the Thermaic Gulf, photos for fashion magazines, video clips and countless receptions and parties. It makes 30-minute trips daily starting from the White Tower, heading to the commercial port and back. Its capacity is about 160 people. The ship is 25 meters long and 20 m high (14 m. Mast), while its draft is 2.8 meters.

name: Midland Railway
description: Midland Railroad is home of the Snowglobe Express Christmas Train that operates Mid November thru December 31. The Snowglobe Express is a one of a kind 12 mile round trip excursion where passengers ride in decorated vintage train cars to the Snowglobe Christmas Village, where they get off the train and spend 45- 60 minutes. The village is a magical world where they can enjoy Christmas music, amazing lighting, roasting s'mores, and see live reindeer. children also have the opportunity to visit Santa and deliver their letters to his Elf aboard our over the top decorated U.S. Postal vintage mail car. Food and drink are also available for purchase. The train operates on a line that was originally constructed in 1867. Midland Railroad also offers train rides at various times through out the year, with other event type trains.

name: Bigfoot Discovery Expedition
description: My family did the Bigfoot Discovery Expedition July 2021.  Everyone had a good time until the end.  Loved feeding the cows and looking at the scenery.  We do not see how the ending fit with finding Bigfoot.The truck drove into a building, the lights were turned out, a foggy mist was released and hot air blown at you from what felt like a heat lamp that was turned on high. In addition to this, monitors played a scene from a drug raid with people kneeling to be executed.  There was shouting, shooting and bombs going off.  It was extremely violent.  This lasted 10-15 minutes.  ave gonWe had a 6 and 8 year old with us who got scared.  Unfortunately we didn't read other reviews under the Big Foot Fun Park that mentioned this ending and were not provided this information prior to purchasing tickets and boarding the truck. If we had, we would not have gone.It totally ruined the fun we had been having. Prior to this, I said I’d do it again with another family member.  After sitting through the end, none of us will go back.If they want to continue with this violent ending, I suggest giving participants the choice of sitting through this ordeal or choosing a fun ending that’s actually related to Big Foot.  Even if it’s just seeing some Big Foot cutouts/statues, that would have been preferable.

name: Sandland Adventures
description: Experience the Oregon Dunes and Family Fun Park at Sandland Adventures. Offering tours of the dunes since 1987, our professional drivers will show you a great time while you travel across an impressive natural wonder of endless shifting sand. Choose an exhilarating dune ride on our Sandrails or a relaxing tour on our Giant Dune Buggies. For those who prefer speed and excitement, try either a half hour 10 mile tour or an hour 20 mile tour. These 7 to 10 passenger Long Travel Sandrails have over 20” of suspension travel and plenty of horsepower to take you on an exhilarating ride. If you prefer a slower pace, enjoy our Giant Dune Buggy Tour with many picture opportunities. Informative, scenic and fun describes this one hour dune buggy tour covering approximately 8 miles of dunes and 2 miles of ocean beach. Climbing and descending through the most beautiful, impressive dunes will be an unforgettable experience. We are located less than one mile south of Florence on Hwy 101.

Enjoy an excursion along the Woonasquatucket and Providence Rivers and witness the revitalization of the City, river walks, and waterfront parks. Whether you are celebrating an anniversary or birthday, looking to propose to that special someone, or just on a vacation to the city, a gondola trip is a great way to make your visit to Providence memorable and unique. La Gondola operates three authentic Venetian gondolas along the Providence Riverwalk, accommodating up to six passengers at a time on each gondola. Reservations are highly recommended and are always exclusive to your party. We are open seven days a week from 9 a.m. to 11 p.m. Our season is from 1 May to 31 October, and of course trips are always subject to availability and the weather. La Gondola Providence: For Lovers, For Families, For Everyone.

name: Go City | Dubai
description: Enjoy incredible savings on top Dubai attractions and tours with Go City. There's different activities to suit everyone - all hand-picked by our team of local experts. Discover as many as 45 activities from skyscraper heights to desert delights. Available as an instant digital pass with the free Go City app. Includes At The Top - Burj Khalifa, Aquaventure Waterpark at Atlantis the Palm, and more.

The cuisine is meticulously presented, the service is attentive and discreet, your eyes will sparkle as never before... name: Fourth Ward
description: Beautiful hidden gem of a neighborhood in Uptown Charlotte. I recommend downloading the Friends of Fourth Ward walking tour. We were a bit disappointed that some homes had been painted more boring whites and greys since the last time we visited a few years ago. They have lost some of their Victorian charm, but at least they are still standing.

name: Great River Road
description: Part of a 3,000-mile network of roads called the Great River Road National Scenic Byway, Wisconsin's Great River Road is made up of several highways covering about 300 miles from Kieler in the state's southwestern corner to St. Croix Falls, about an hour northeast of Minneapolis-St. Paul.

name: Medellin Metrocable
description: The Metrocable is a gondola lift that links the city center with the surrounding hillside communities. More than just an efficient mode of transportation, it is also a convenient and affordable way to see Medellin, offering breathtaking views of the city and surrounding countryside. Your regular metro ticket covers the cost of the 30-minute ride, and you can take the trip multiple times as long as you do not exit the station. The hilltop residents make their daily commute on the Metrocable so it can get busy during peak hours. And take note of the timing of the last car from the top. – Tripadvisor

name: Cala Del Moraig
description: Se trata de una playa de ensueño, donde arena y grava crean un mosaico bajo el sol. Esta playa de arena blancas tiene aguas tan claras que te invitan a explorar el silencio del Mediterráneo. Este lugar se llama Cala Moraig. Es un tesoro en la Costa Blanca, escondida detrás del macizo del puig llorença perfecto para quienes buscan experiencias únicas como el submarinismo. Cala del moraig se encuentra en Benitatxell, entre Xàbia y Moraira, esta playa une aventura, relax y amor por la naturaleza.

name: Club Roxy Prague
description: Roxy is one of Prague's oldest and best-known clubs, and over the years has attracted big name DJ's as well as bands. The slightly dilapidated interior and big open spaces gives Roxy more of a warehouse feel than a modern club, the rawness of it fitting the style of music. name: Burriana Beach
description:
Burriana Beach can be a challenge for anyone who has problems walking - not when you are down on the promenade but walking down the hill(and back up again) can take a real effort.  There is limited parking near the sea front but a multi story a little further behind the main area.

Once on the promenade the beach area is flat and backed by a number of bars restaurants and shops (with parking if you are lucky to get a space) so it makes for a pleasant walk.  The beach itself is made up of sand and small gravel/pebbles and is well sheltered so waves are not too high in normal conditions.  There are areas where you can hire sunbeds and umbrellas or bring some beach chairs and a cheap beach umbrella for a picnic.

On an evening around about 6 to 7pm I noticed more parking spaces on the street behind the promenade if you intend to eat there.

name: Space Needle
description: Located in the Lower Queen Anne neighborhood, this iconic landmark and observation tower was built for the 1962 World’s Fair. Perch on the glass benches known as “Skyrisers” and gaze out of floor-to-ceiling windows, snap a selfie at the outdoor deck, or head upstairs to The Loupe, an indoor lounge featuring the world’s first and only rotating glass floor. Here, you’ll be greeted with 360-degree views of the downtown Seattle skyline, Mount Rainier, Elliot Bay, and the Olympic and Cascade Mountains. For a smooth-sailing experience, it’s best to pre-purchase a timed ticket. Space Needle is also a part of CityPASS. – Tripadvisor

name: Mari Mari Cultural Village
description: The village is located about 25 minutes away from the city. The journey will take you to long roads surrounded by a rich spectrum of greenery and over arched by wild blue skies. In the village, the colors of cultural diversity are not an issue but rather our pride, where you can savor the soul of Sabah. Upon arrival at the entrance of the village, you will be ushered to the warmth of different homes of the ethnicity of Sabah. Each home was built by descendants of the tribes they represent and offer you a truly genuine experience seeing everything in and around the village lends to its magical prowess of taking you back in time. Not only does this village portray these tribes (5 tribes) through the architectural genius of their traditional houses, but also through a range of simulated lives of the olden epoch by the residents of the village. Acquaint yourself with each tribe as they let you come into their house and their simple yet intricate lives. As you traverse the village, you will find demonstration huts along the main houses in which daily activities of old times come into life. For example, the making of blowpipe, starting a fire (from bamboo), tattoo-making (and its symbolisms) and etc. By the end of your journey into the past, you have been given a setting for you to see, hear, taste and feel the uniqueness of what Sabah truly is. An unforgettable encounter of our Sabahan homeland... AS IT IS... AS IT WAS...

name: St. Kitts Scenic Railway
description: The narrow gauge St. Kitts scenic railway is one of the most beautiful train rides in the world. Originally built in 1912 to deliver sugarcane from the fields to the sugar mill in Basseterre, the "Last Railway in the West Indies" now provides a fascinating way for visitors to see the island from the comfort of modern passenger train cars and sightseeing buses. The railway hugs the Northeastern coastline where spectacular vistas of ocean, surf, cliffs, and lush vegetation surround you. The train rolls across tall steel bridges spanning deep ""ghuts"", or canyons, and winds through small villages and farms. Dark green rainforests are skirted by rippling fields of sugar can, with the volcanic cone of Mt. Liamuiga rising above the railway. This unique rail and highway experience allows visitors the opportunity to see the island in a very short period of time. Your guide will point out all the sights as the train passes old sugar estates with abandoned windmills and chimneys.

name: Revolution Rail Co.

name: Indiana Dunes State Park
description: Indiana Dunes State Park consists of 2,182 acres of primitive, beautiful, historic and unique Hoosier landscape. It lies at the north end of State Road 49 in Porter County, and includes more than three miles of beautiful beach along Lake Michigan’s southern shore. In the early 1900s scientists, recreationists and nature enthusiasts, recognizing the value and potential of the Indiana dunes area, fought to have the region preserved. As a result, in 1925, the state park was established.Large sand dunes, located beyond the entire shoreline, have taken thousands of years to form, and tower nearly 200 feet above Lake Michigan. A wide range of habitats and plant species are found in the park, with vegetation stabilizing some of the sand. These habitats provide homes for many types of plants and animals. The lake also provides habitat for many aquatic species, as well as a constantly changing fishery.Indiana Dunes State Park features a wide variety of habitats, including beach, sand dunes, black oak forest, wooded wetlands, and a button-bush marsh. Together, these areas contain some of the most diverse flora and fauna in the Midwest. Botanists from across the country enjoy studying the unusual collection of plant life. Other interesting features include “tree graveyards” (places where forests have been buried by sand and then, more recently, re-exposed by wind erosion). “Tree graveyards” can be seen in Big Blowout, near Trail 10. The Indiana Dunes area also is renowned throughout the Midwest for its birding. Visit the Nature Center to ask about good birding locations.Indiana Dunes State Park is surrounded by Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore, a federally administered park comprising approximately 15,000 acres.

name: Playa La Pared
description: This is a beautiful beach that is popular with surfers, but people really underestimate the danger here.  There are significant rip currents and no life guards.  Yesterday a 26 year old tourist was lost in a rip current and we watched the coast guard and local rescue teams search for hours to no avail.  Just last week another adult male tourist drowned shortly after a surfing lesson.  You really need to know what you’re doing to swim or surf at a beach like this.

name: Montana Vortex and House of Mystery
description: I have been to two other vortex attractions (NC, OR) and my partner has been to the one in CA. We both agreed that this is the best vortex attraction, by far, compared to the others we have experienced. This one, for some reason, feels more real. Maybe it is because the trees grow in a bent direction or maybe they had more effective demonstrations. There were far more things to try at this vortex than the others, which mainly focus on height changes. Some of the hands on activities are more engaging than others, but there is a wide variety. The guides are also great. They have a lot of enthusiasm and really sell the mystique. The hours can be a little confusing as there is not much information online. It seems the last tour is usually somewhere in the 4:00 hour, so I would say plan to arrive by 4 if you want to catch a tour. This is a ton of fun and should be the number one attraction in your planned time outside of Glacier. Check it out.
